concerns.text: FR-002 (facial extraction) and FR-003 (vocal extraction) lack functional implementation tasks. T013 and T014 are marked with [ ] (unchecked) and their descriptions reference truncated/failed code states in the analyze report, leaving the core data pipeline broken. The spec requires these to be implemented to satisfy US-1.

FR-004 (intra-modal consistency metric) is unimplemented. T015 is marked [ ] (unchecked) and the analyze report indicates `code/compute_metrics.py` is truncated and `metrics.csv` is missing. Without this task, the primary research objective (US-1) cannot be achieved.

FR-001 (dataset validation and fallback) is partially covered by T012, but the 'trigger a controlled data collection study' aspect is not implemented as an executable pipeline task. T012c_doc is documentation only. The spec requires the system to initiate this protocol if synthetic fallback fails, but no task exists to execute the collection workflow.

Task T017 appears twice (Phase 3 and Phase 5) with conflicting dependencies. In Phase 3 it depends on T025_impl (which hasn't run), and in Phase 5 it is a dependency for T025_exec. This duplication and circular dependency creates ambiguity in the execution order for the 'associational only' disclaimer injection.
Task T033 is duplicated at the end of the file (appears in Phase 8 and again as a standalone item). This is a stale tag/duplicate entry that should be consolidated.
